standard_prerequisites: morphisms of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces representable by algebraic spaces and flat in the transformation sense of the bootstrap chapter

etale morphisms are flat and flatness composes

flatness of a limit of ring maps from flatness of the reductions
core_obligations: Prove that a morphism f : X to Y of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces which is representable by algebraic spaces and flat in the bootstrap transformation sense is flat in the taut-map sense of the chapter
proof_roadmap: On affine etale charts U to X and V to Y the induced U to V is a taut adic map B to A with the reduction diagrams cartesian

For any scheme T over V run the flatness chain: X x_Y T flat over T implies U x_Y T flat over T (etale hence flat U to X and composition), equals U x_V V x_Y T, descends to U x_V V x_Y T flat over V x_Y T by the etale-flat up-down lemma, and pulls back to U x_V T flat over T
This says U to V is flat in the transformation sense, i.e. each reduction B/J^n to A/J^nA is flat
Flatness of B to A follows from flatness of the reductions by the limit flatness lemma
